summary: Nvidia's CEO resigned before the open (NVDA -5.5% vs QQQ flat after opening -13%); the overhang short is exited as played out. Twelve holds, no other wrong_if has happened.

reviews.reason: The board probe the trade was waiting on has ended: at about 9:00 AM ET NVIDIA announced Huang stepped down as CEO and director (CNBC live blog; SEC filing 11-12). NVDA opened down more than 13% and has bought back more than half of it (about -5.5% at midday vs QQQ flat), so the move the overhang was meant to bring has happened. Remaining items (House testimony, DOJ) are follow-on, not the reason for the trade.

At BMO (10:00 AM ET, Investing.com) ServiceNow's SVP Josh Kahn, not the CFO, said seats grew year on year; no raise or reaffirmation of cRPO or subscription guidance, so wrong_if has not happened. No upgrades on seat growth found; KeyBanc downgraded WDAY. Pre-close should check why HUBS is +7.3% today (no news found) and whether the basket is regaining its loss against IGV.

NOVT -3.1% vs XLK -0.2%. Baird cut its target to $175 from $194 (MarketBeat, 11-12); no coverage found of the 11-11 Baird conference. The CFO's 'conservative' remark and the Stockport margin hit were on the 11-10 call, before the take, with no revenue figure for the shortfall. Pre-close: check for any Baird-conference write-up quantifying the shortfall.

HUM -0.1% vs UNH +0.6%. No CY2028 payment or star-rating rule (CMS-4214-P of 10-16 has neither; the second rule is not out); no peer cost-trend warning found. Form 144s: officer Joseph Ventura 5,495 vested shares ($2.35M, 11-09) and a director's 440 shares; routine vested-unit sales, not judged large. Pre-close may confirm Ventura's role.

Memory fading as planned: MU -3.2%, SNDK -4.2%, WDC/STX/SIMO about -1% vs SMH -1.0% (24/7 Wall St. ties it to the Nvidia news). Spot DRAM and NAND still slipping per TrendForce (latest 11-03/11-11 readings). AMAT reports after today's close; the wrong_if test is tomorrow's session.
CVS flat vs XLV +0.4%; no news checked beyond price. Last session; the time limit closes it today.
U -1.0% vs XLC flat; losing is not a reason. Last session; the stop and time limit decide.
OUST -2.0% vs XLI flat, gain still held. Last session; the time limit closes it today.
QCOM +1.7% vs SPY +0.2%, rebound running. Last session; the time limit closes it today.
NVO -1.2% vs XLV +0.4%, in the short's favour. Last session; the time limit closes it today.
UBER -1.4% vs SPY +0.2%; losing is not a reason. Last session; the stop and time limit decide.
